findings.public_finding: Internal data access, processing and storage are subject to subscription or add-on terms; data may not be cached beyond permitted timeframes.
findings.mfx_impact: Do not start Drive market-data chunks or assume perpetual replay rights.

findings.public_finding: Retention is subscription- and third-party-restricted; terms describe deletion requirements after termination and compliance exceptions.
findings.mfx_impact: Require exact cache TTL, deletion-on-termination and raw/derived-data contract before Drive write.

findings.public_finding: Individual and business use differ; redistribution and commercial display require applicable business and/or separate licensing.
findings.mfx_impact: Free or individual access cannot be assumed to authorize MFX production or redistribution.

findings.public_finding: Forex API v2 describes weighted/composite forex pricing, mid-price streaming updates and aggregated candlesticks.
findings.mfx_impact: Do not treat Forex v2 mid/OHLC as broker-native executable BID/ASK.

findings.public_finding: Official WebSocket documentation includes a conditional price-event example containing bid and ask for XAU/USD.
findings.mfx_impact: An example is not proof of availability for every FX symbol, a historical BID/ASK API or broker-matched spreads.

findings.section: Forex available endpoints and historical coverage
findings.public_finding: Forex catalog advertises /time_series historical aggregate OHLC and /quote and /price, with published intraday history window.
findings.mfx_impact: Published catalog coverage is not account entitlement, first-known proof or native historical BID/ASK.

findings.public_finding: Historical series requests can use start_date and end_date; support describes a 5,000-point maximum per request.
findings.mfx_impact: Cost/credit/pagination and source replay plan require separate validation; this is only OHLC request capability.

findings.public_finding: Redistribution or external display of data is restricted to explicit tier/add-on rights or a separate agreement.
findings.mfx_impact: Public GitHub must contain no licensed raw feed; sharing Drive chunks cannot be presumed legal.

findings.public_finding: Public pricing distinguishes plans, credits and usage purposes; capacity and price depend on selected tier.
findings.mfx_impact: Do not infer current MFX entitlement, quota, billing status or authorize paid Cloud runs.

findings.public_finding: Documentation states Forex v2 operates 24/7 and streams mid-price updates; it does not establish a broker-specific first-known revision trail.
findings.mfx_impact: A public bar timestamp or exchange calendar is not audited first-known_utc, quote validity or executable broker calendar.

requirements.required_written_proof: Exact account/tier/product right to call FX API, and purpose non-display internal/production.
Historical product entitlement by symbol/interval and exact backtest/replay use permission.
Explicit Google Drive or third-party Cloud raw data storage allowance, locality and encryption conditions.
Exact permitted per-product retention/cache TTL, renewal/expiry and 30-day termination cleanup applicability.
Explicit distribution/display permission and attribution if MFX has third-party consumers.
Allowed indicator/signal storage and derived data rules, anti-reconstruction and storage duration.
Reproducible historical replay and time-as-of revision usage rights for QA/backtesting.
Instrument-specific real-time native BID and ASK with side semantics, spread and matched broker/product, not composite MID.
Bar open/close timestamps, supported MFX intervals, HTF formation and licensed access for account.
Dedicated historical time-indexed BID+ASK per instrument and broker, sample schema, corrections and quote revisions.
Authentic first-available/ingest latency and revision-known timestamps for causal backtest at decision instant.
Correction events and revision order, reproducible as-of source revision exposure.
Forex session/trading holidays, source DST and broker timezone versus provider always-on schedule.
Proof provider composite FX quotes align to specified executable broker account/symbol conditions.
Actual tier quotas, billable credits, symbol/TF product restrictions, estimated cloud cost and budget approval.

vendor_inquiry_questions.question: For the intended MFX account/tier and currency products, may the data be used programmatically for non-display internal quantitative research and eventually production? Please identify permitted usage and any extra agreement.

May raw historical FX OHLC, real-time quotes, and derived indicators be stored as immutable chunks in a private Google Drive cloud cache? Specify per-product maximum retention, permitted replay/backtest usage and termination/deletion obligations.

Is there an entitled API/WS endpoint returning genuine, timestamped historical BID and ASK per currency pair, with vendor/source identity and optional broker/product-specific executable pricing? Please provide schema and sample metadata without customer credentials.

Do bars and quote events expose first_known/first_published, bar-close timestamps, revisions and corrected historical as-of replay? Clarify event-time versus publish/receive time, local timezone and DST.
Which plans/add-ons cover M5, M15, M30, H1, H4, D1 and W1, historical depth and WebSocket quotes? Provide per-minute credit weights, 429 policy, cost estimate and commercial/non-display terms.

Do your composite forex mid rates or optional BID/ASK quotes correspond to any specified broker's executed bid/ask/spreads? If not, what source/provider identities and caveats should a research backtest apply?
